security_audit.summary: The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to environment or locally stored credentials. The instructions also lack explicit safeguards for passing product inputs to the shell and validating billing links from errors. No evidence of an encoded payload or deliberate credential exfiltration was found in the skill text.

remediation.suggestion: Require an explicitly approved CLI release with verified integrity and locked dependencies. Remove automatic download and execution from authentication checks and product lookups.
Use a scoped credential from an approved secret store. Pass it only to the verified client, avoid legacy variables, and replace persistent JSON storage with a secure credential store.
Validate product IDs and supported HTTPS URLs before lookup. Pass each input as a separate process argument without shell interpolation, or use a structured MCP call.
Display only the fixed provider billing URL. Do not substitute links from error responses.

content.user_title: Compare Douyin Products Side by Side
content.value_statement: Douyin listings can show different pack sizes, variants, and discount conditions. Compare selected products in one table with sources, price conditions, and gaps clearly marked.
actual_capabilities: Compares two to five selected products from Douyin links, product IDs, or details you provide.
Looks up product details through the SocialDataX CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Checks whether variants, pack sizes, units, and price conditions support a fair comparison.
Calculates unit prices when the price and quantity are clear.
Produces a Markdown table with sources, observation times, seller claims, and missing fields.
limitations: Live lookups require authorized SocialDataX access. The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package.
The skill compares only products you select. It does not search for new competitors.
It does not substitute video comments for product reviews or infer sales, growth, or market share.
It does not estimate profit without cost and fee data or rank products without sufficient evidence.

use_cases.title: Compare pack sizes before buying
use_cases.description: Check quantities, unit prices, and coupon conditions for products on your shortlist.

use_cases.title: Review competitor listings
use_cases.description: Compare selected listings by specifications and advertised selling points. Keep seller claims separate from independent evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a sourced comparison brief
use_cases.description: Build a table for stakeholders that records source links, observation times, and information that still needs verification.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two products
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two Douyin listings: [product A link] and [product B link]. Show the prices, specifications, and missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a shortlist using basic listing details.

prompt_templates.title: Check unit prices
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [product ID A] and [product ID B] for pack size and price. Show coupon prices separately. Calculate unit prices only when quantities are clear.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare offers sold in different pack sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Review seller claims
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these four product records using only the details I provide. Separate seller claims from verified specifications and list what I should check next.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a merchandising comparison without a live lookup.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceable comparison brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these five selected listings using my criteria: [criteria]. Separate variants and price conditions, cite each source and observation time, and explain where evidence prevents a ranking.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an auditable comparison for stakeholders.

output_examples.input: Compare two supplied packs. Product A lists 12 units at CNY 24. Product B lists 20 units at CNY 30 after a coupon.
output: Product A: CNY 2.00 per unit at the listed price.
Product B: CNY 1.50 per unit after the coupon. The price without the coupon was not provided.
Source: Supplied product records. The observation time was not provided.

output_examples.input: Compare three supplied Douyin listings for capacity and advertised benefits. Product C has no listed capacity.
output: Products A and B list capacities of 500 mL and 750 mL. Product C does not list a capacity.
The seller describes Product B as leakproof. No independent test was provided.
Confirm the capacity of Product C before comparing prices per liter.

best_practices: Provide exact product links or IDs and say which variants or comparison criteria matter.
Record the observation time, currency, pack size, and discount conditions for each price.
Use supplied product records or an approved authenticated connection. Keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Do not use a video ID when the lookup requires a product ID.
Do not present coupon prices and standard prices as directly comparable without labeling their conditions.
Do not treat seller claims as verified facts or rank products when essential data is missing.

faq.question: How many products can I compare?
faq.answer: Provide two to five selected Douyin products. Use product links, product IDs, or details you already have.

faq.question: Can I compare products without SocialDataX access?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the listing details yourself. Live lookup requires an authorized SocialDataX CLI or MCP connection.

faq.question: Should I paste my API key into chat?
faq.answer: No. Keep credentials out of chat and use an approved authentication method in your execution environment.

faq.question: How are sale prices handled?
faq.answer: Coupon prices, promotional prices, and price ranges are labeled separately. Unit prices are calculated only when the quantity and pricing basis are clear.

faq.question: Can this skill verify reviews or sales?
faq.answer: No. The workflow does not collect product reviews, substitute video comments, or infer actual sales or market share.

faq.question: What happens when a field is missing?
faq.answer: The comparison marks the field as missing and identifies what to verify. It does not guess values or force a ranking.
